desc: Skip any scene stopped by another controller's B: the prologue (aaa_00, story 0), START and B held together 60 frames at frame 60 (a B already down as the skip starts doesn't stop it), then controller 2's B 240 frames in: 'stopped by B', back to normal, Mario still held; A plays the rest out
log_must: \[sceneskip\] stopped by B after [1-9][0-9]{2} frames \(map '[a-z0-9_]+', Mario held\)
\[sceneskip\] back to normal: speed 100%, every frame drawn, sound on
